caption: The drawing depicts a cylindrical wooden container with an unattached, matching lid floating above it. The container is illustrated in beige and light brown tones, with segments outlined to suggest individual wooden staves. It has a metal handle attached to both sides, connected by visible fixtures. Midway down the container, there is a wide horizontal band decorated with a colorful drawing of various fruits, including peaches, pears, grapes, strawberries, and possibly quinces, rendered in shades of yellow, pink, purple, red, and green. Below this fruit band, a thick dark green horizontal stripe encircles the container. The lid is round, matches the container in color and material, and appears to fit snugly on top. The entire composition is centered on a plain, lightly yellowed background with a faint rectangular border.
title: Wooden Pail
